content:
MyKingBet Casino brings together 14,006 casino games from 97+ providers, live dealer tables, sports betting, horse racing, and e-sports. We support multiple currencies, provide 24/7 customer assistance, and offer a VIP rewards system with missions, Points, and exclusive prizes.

You can explore 1,108 Live Casino games, 1,436 Mini Games, and a sportsbook with pre-match and in-play markets. We also offer a three-part welcome package, daily cashback, Free Spins, and additional promotions for regular players.

Promotions

MyKingBet Casino offers bonuses for new customers and ongoing promotions for casino and sports betting. Our welcome package covers the first three deposits, while daily and weekly offers provide additional rewards.

The three welcome deposit bonuses are:

Deposit Casino Bonus Free Spins Min. Deposit
First 150% up to €750 30-250 FS according to deposit amount €20
Second 125% up to €200 120 FS €20
Third 75% up to €300 - €20

The welcome bonuses apply to casino slots and must be activated on the corresponding deposit. Each offer is valid for 14 days after activation, with a maximum bet of €5 per spin. Maximum withdrawable winnings are limited to five times the initial bonus amount.

The MyKingBet promotions collection also includes:

  • 150 Free Spins: Register and receive 150 Free Spins worth €30 on Big Bass Bonanza 1000. Each spin is worth €0.20, and the offer is valid for seven days.
  • Daily Slots Cashback: Get 10% cashback on daily net losses from €5 to €100, 15% from €100 to €500, 20% from €500 to €1,500, and 25% from €1,500 upwards.
  • 12% Weekly Live Casino Cashback: Receive 12% cashback on eligible weekly net losses in Live Casino, with a minimum weekly net loss of €200.
  • 3% Instant Deposit Bonus: Get an additional 3% on every successful deposit, with no minimum deposit or maximum bonus limit.
  • 150% Kickoff Free Bet: Receive a Free Bet worth 150% of a qualifying pre-match accumulator bet, up to €150, after meeting the deposit and betting conditions.

You can activate available welcome bonuses through My Profile - Bonuses - Available Offers after making the corresponding deposit. Other promotions may be credited automatically or require separate activation. Check the individual offer terms before claiming a reward.

VIP Club

The MyKingBet VIP Club turns player activity into rewards through XP, Points, Daily Missions, and Spin the Wheel. Complete tasks, move through the VIP levels, and exchange accumulated Points for rewards in our VIP Store.

Our VIP system uses two separate balances:

  • XP: Determines your VIP level and status. Earn it through deposit missions and Spin the Wheel.
  • Points: Your VIP Store currency. Collect Points from missions and wheel prizes, then redeem them for Bonus Money, Free Spins, and special rewards.

MyKing Casino features eight VIP categories, each offering new opportunities as you advance.

VIP Level XP Requirements Main Benefits
StarterEntry levelStarter Wheel, Daily Missions, Store access

Adventurer700-1,500 XPAdventurer Wheel, level-up rewards

Each level from Traveler to Eternal has three stages, while Legend includes five stages. Rewards are available at individual milestones, and higher levels unlock additional opportunities through missions, wheels, and the Store.

Daily Missions provide recurring tasks and Spin the Wheel attempts. Deposit Missions award XP, while Special Missions introduce limited-time rewards. Only completed and settled activities count towards mission progress.

In the VIP Store, you can exchange Points for bonus funds, Free Spins, or special promotional items. Available rewards and conditions are displayed before redemption.

Casino

At MyKingBet Casino, we offer 14,006 games from more than 97 software providers, including online slots, table games, and other casino formats. Explore titles from BGaming, Evoplay, Nolimit City, RubyPlay, and other developers.

Choose from classic fruit slots, modern video slots, bonus-feature games, and titles with different volatility levels. Our casino collection also includes blackjack, roulette, baccarat, and poker-style games.

Browse games by category or provider, discover new releases, and check game features and betting limits before you play. Enjoy responsive gameplay on desktop and mobile devices without switching between separate services.

We regularly expand our MyKing Casino collection with different themes, game mechanics, and bonus features. Find your preferred provider, explore the available slots, or switch directly to table games from our casino catalogue.

Live Casino

The MyKingBet Live Casino features 1,108 games from more than 22 providers, including real-time Blackjack, Roulette, Baccarat, Poker, and Live Game Shows hosted by professional dealers.

Our Live Casino collection includes:

  • Live Roulette: Multiple roulette tables with different betting limits and formats.
  • Live Blackjack: Dealer-hosted blackjack games with a selection of table stakes.
  • Live Baccarat: Baccarat tables with player, banker, and tie betting markets.
  • Live Poker: Live poker variants featuring different table rules and formats.
  • Live Game Shows: Interactive dealer-hosted games with bonus features and special rounds.

MyKingBet Casino makes these live games available through a browser-based interface, including on compatible mobile devices. Choose a table, review its limits, and follow the current round in real time.

Live Casino players can also benefit from our 12% Weekly Cashback promotion on eligible weekly net losses of at least €200. The offer is calculated separately from Daily Slots Cashback.

Mini Games

At MyKingBet, we offer 1,436 Mini Games, including Crash Games, Plinko, Dice, Hi-Lo, and Lottery titles. Explore quick-round formats, straightforward controls, and games with different multiplier mechanics.

Our Mini Games collection includes:

  • Crash Games: Multiplier-based rounds with cash-out decisions.
  • Plinko: Peg-board games featuring different payout positions.
  • Dice: Number-based games with adjustable betting options in supported titles.
  • Hi-Lo: Higher-or-lower prediction games.
  • Lottery: Number-draw formats with game-specific payouts.

Choose your preferred Mini Game, review the available betting options, and start playing directly from our casino catalogue. Each title provides its own rules, limits, and payout information.

Switch between quick-round Mini Games, traditional slots, and other MyKingBet Casino categories from one account. Our browser-based interface lets you access the collection on desktop and mobile devices.

Sports

The MyKingBet Sportsbook covers pre-match and live betting across football, basketball, tennis, ice hockey, baseball, volleyball, American football, and other sporting events.

Our sportsbook includes markets for match results, team and player statistics, individual periods, and tournament outcomes. Available leagues and competitions depend on the current betting schedule.

At MyKingBet, you can choose from several betting formats and features:

  • 1X2, Double Chance, and Draw No Bet: Match-result markets.
  • Over/Under and Handicaps: Total-based and adjusted-score markets.
  • Correct Score and Player Props: Exact results and individual player statistics.
  • Single, Combo, and System Bets: Different ways to combine selections.
  • Bet Builder: Combine supported markets from the same event into one bet.
  • Cash Out: Accept an offered early settlement on supported bets.
  • Early Payout: Receive an early winning settlement when predefined conditions are met on eligible markets.

Live betting markets update during sporting events. Bet acceptance may be delayed or temporarily suspended during significant match situations, and odds may change before a wager is confirmed.

MyKingBet Casino also offers a 150% Kickoff Free Bet promotion. Make a qualifying deposit and place an eligible pre-match accumulator bet to receive a Free Bet worth up to €150, subject to the offer conditions.

The MyKingBet Sportsbook applies event-specific settlement rules. For example, football match-result markets generally exclude extra time unless stated otherwise, while basketball, tennis, and other sports follow their respective market regulations.

Horse Racing

MyKingBet Horse Racing provides betting markets for eligible racing events, including Win, Place, and Top 2 selections. Review available runners, odds, and race information before placing a wager.

Our horse racing markets include:

  • Win Betting: Select a runner to finish first.
  • Place Betting: Select a runner to finish in an eligible placing position. For races with eight or more runners, the rules provide payouts for first, second, and third places.
  • Top 2 Betting: Select a runner to finish first or second. This market requires at least five runners.

MyKingBet applies official racing results to settle wagers. Important settlement rules include:

  • Dead Heat: Winnings are adjusted according to the number of runners sharing the relevant finishing position.
  • Scratched Runner: The stake on a scratched runner is refunded.
  • Abandoned or Transferred Race: Affected single bets are generally void, while Combo Bets are recalculated.
  • Postponed Race: Bets may remain valid when the event is rescheduled at the same venue within 48 hours, subject to the racing rules.
  • Deductions: Changes to the declared field may result in deductions from winning returns.

The racing rules also address greyhound and harness racing markets. All selections are settled according to the applicable race conditions and official results.

E-Sports

MyKingBet E-Sports covers competitive gaming events in Counter-Strike 2, Dota 2, League of Legends, and Valorant. Explore available tournaments, pre-match odds, and live betting markets for match winners, individual maps, and in-game results.

Depending on the game and event, the MyKingBet sportsbook supports different e-sports selections, including match outcomes, map results, and round-related markets.

Our e-sports betting rules provide specific conditions for each title:

  • Counter-Strike 2: Markets follow the official match format and results. A round restart does not automatically cancel a bet.
  • Dota 2: Settlement depends on official map results, with specific rules for player disconnections and early administrative decisions.
  • League of Legends: Map markets follow the official results and applicable rules for interrupted or incomplete matches.
  • Valorant: Round and map results are used for settlement, with separate conditions for team withdrawals and technical interruptions.

MyKingBet generally settles e-sports bets using official tournament or game-stream results. If a match is postponed and not rescheduled within 24 hours of its original start time, affected bets are void under the stated rules.

You can explore the available e-sports schedule through the MyKingBet Sportsbook, review the markets for each event, and follow accepted wagers in the My Bets section.
